remarks: Elevate your living experience in the heart of Downtown Stamford from the penthouse level of The Biltmore. This stunning 1BR 1Bth apartment offers breathtaking views of the City and Long Island Sound through its wall-to-wall windows. The fully equipped kitchen features brand-new stainless steel appliances such as GE Cafe series oven, and microwave, LG French door refrigerator, an Insinkerator garbage disposal, Kohler and Grohe faucets, A/O Smith hot water tank with an added 10 warranty (8 years left). The living/dining area offers a spacious and comfortable retreat. The large bedroom includes a walk-in closet, an en-suite featuring a Toto toilet. The Nest-controlled central air ensures year-round comfort. The Biltmore is a luxury hi-rise building with a 24-hour concierge, state-of-the-art fitness center, shuttle service to the train, a community room, a courtyard, and pet-friendly amenities. Additional features include storage options and garage parking for 2 cars ($110/mo per car). Its prime location offers easy access to highways, Metro North, restaurants, coffee shops, a farmers market, theaters, and UCONN. Plus, you're just steps away from the famous Bedford Street. Bonus - The cooler tank assessment is fully paid off.
